exports.index.js: public staging exports (config.js, adapter.js except invalid, service.js)

auth.identity: selected connection only; no credential mutation, cache, refresh, replay or failover

envelope.request: { model, query, documents (string | {text}), top_n: top_n ?? documents.length, return_documents: return_documents !== false }
envelope.response: { id, model, results: [{ index, relevance_score, document?: { text } }], usage? } rebuilt from validated upstream results and caller document text

integration.rerank: open-sse/handlers/rerankCore.js handleRerankCore: dispatch handleSiliconflowRerankNative for provider 'siliconflow' before generic deriveRerankUrl/passthrough; the generic path already derives the same URL with the same Bearer headers but forwards the body verbatim and relays the raw upstream body
integration.routeKind: src/sse/handlers/modelKind.js modelKindError: reranker IDs are unknown to the siliconflow registry entry, so they are currently dispatched untyped (not rejected) unless a custom/synced row declares another kind; registration adds siliconflowRerankMetadata.models and rerankConfig so the catalog claims kind 'rerank'
integration.provider: existing open-sse/providers/registry/siliconflow.js: add serviceKinds including 'llm' and 'rerank' (entry currently declares none), the kind:'rerank' models and rerankConfig only; preserve transport, validateUrl, modelsFetcher, passthroughModels and chat models
integration.discovery: existing src/app/api/providers/[id]/models/modelsConfig.js and providerModelsConfig.js siliconflow createOpenAIModelsConfig('https://api.siliconflow.com/v1/models') plus registry modelsFetcher are equivalent; staged discovery adds bounded safe-ID validation, no replacement required
integration.catalog: docs/providers/catalog.mdx and shared catalogs updated at serial registration only

restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions

text documents only (string or {text}); no rank_fields, structured/JSON documents, media, streaming or extra fields (e.g. SiliconFlow instruction, max_chunks_per_doc, overlap_tokens are refused, not forwarded)
up to 1024 documents, each and query at most 20000 characters; top_n 1..documents.length
custom safe model IDs allowed; only the four pinned catalog models claim the rerank serviceKind
30s default/60s maximum total deadline, 8MiB success and 16KiB error response bounds
upstream error messages and bodies are never relayed (the source relays them)
no synthetic billed_units/search_units; unknown cost stays unknown; SiliconFlow meta.tokens receipts are not mapped (only numeric usage fields)
discovery does not retain pricing/free-tier evidence fields
no async jobs, polling, artifact URL fetching, browser or WebSocket protocol
